entries.title: Psalms 34:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David when he pretended madness before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.>> I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise [shall] continually [be] in my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:2
segments: My soul shall make its boast in the LORD; The humble shall hear [of it] and be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 34:3
segments: Oh, magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.

entries.title: Psalms 34:4
segments: I sought the LORD, and He heard me, And delivered me from all my fears.

entries.title: Psalms 34:5
segments: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 34:6
segments: This poor man cried out, and the LORD heard [him], And saved him out of all his troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:7
segments: The angel of the LORD encamps all around those who fear Him, And delivers them.

entries.title: Psalms 34:8
segments: Oh, taste and see that the LORD [is] good; Blessed [is] the man [who] trusts in Him!

entries.title: Psalms 34:9
segments: Oh, fear the LORD, you His saints! [There is] no want to those who fear Him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:10
segments: The young lions lack and suffer hunger; But those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good [thing].

entries.title: Psalms 34:11
segments: ¶Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 34:12
segments: Who [is] the man [who] desires life, And loves [many] days, that he may see good?

entries.title: Psalms 34:13
segments: Keep your tongue from evil, And your lips from speaking deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 34:14
segments: Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.

entries.title: Psalms 34:15
segments: The eyes of the LORD [are] on the righteous, And His ears [are open] to their cry.

entries.title: Psalms 34:16
segments: The face of the LORD [is] against those who do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:17
segments: [The righteous] cry out, and the LORD hears, And delivers them out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:18
segments: The LORD [is] near to those who have a broken heart, And saves such as have a contrite spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 34:19
segments: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous, But the LORD delivers him out of them all.

entries.title: Psalms 34:20
segments: He guards all his bones; Not one of them is broken.

entries.title: Psalms 34:21
segments: Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

entries.title: Psalms 34:22
segments: The LORD redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who trust in Him shall be condemned.
